scope: Completed single-seed matched-count pilot; all 29 compact trial records and final result preserved here. Full runtime captures remain in the referenced run directory; only the earlier six-trial snapshot is currently archived. No feasible gait or algorithm superiority established.

constraints.name: settling duration / (0.8 s + existing 1e-9 s roundoff guard) - 1; unsettled gate failure = 1
failed fraction of all complete planned swing checks
sampled interlink overlap / 0.0001 m; exact zero required

result.scope: One seeded matched-count comparison on a fixed motion family. Full cost must include selector and runtime/audit wall time. Passing these short sampled gates is not timestep/sustained/steering/browser or hardware qualification; no global speed claim.
